theorems.name: Submission.contDiff_one_ball_translation_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ (r : ℝ) (z : Rn n), ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ (x - z) - φ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (‖z‖ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (r + ‖z‖), ‖gradient φ x‖ₑ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
